scope: High-fidelity historical horizontal GBA and GameCube sources outside the exhausted Sketchfab download workflow. No asset promoted to production.
conclusion: No fully qualified quality upgrade was found that can be bundled immediately. Strong GBA candidate needs normal download access and protected embedded-use packaging; laser scans are reference-only; open GameCube candidate is a technically accessible but visually basic fallback.

candidates.creator: rafalstepien
candidates.quality_status: Strongest newly located horizontal GBA prospect from publisher specification; no local geometry render yet. CGTrader technical checks are not proof of factory fidelity.
candidates.actual_download_status: Normal logged-in Free Download workflow; no public redistributable raw URL verified.
candidates.blocking_condition: Terms require incorporated use and reasonable protection against end-user access. Existing loose GLB app resource packaging is not automatically compatible. Do not bundle source asset or commit it to public repository without appropriate permission/protection.
